games.name: DEVASTATION
games.subtitle: Physics Sandbox
games.tagline: Shoot out the supports and watch the tower fall. A destruction sandbox where everything built breaks into chunks, buildings collapse and fire spreads.
games.players: Solo, or private co-op by room code

about.lead: Shoot out the supports. Watch the tower fall.

about.p: DEVASTATION VR is a destruction sandbox. Everything built breaks into chunks, buildings collapse when their supports go, towers topple whole and fire spreads.

list: The Annihilator laser cuts through buildings
Railgun, tesla gun, black-hole launcher, scoped sniper
C4, napalm, cluster bombs, airstrikes and a nuke
Red vs Blue: about a hundred soldiers in squads, with tanks and jets
Cops vs criminals vs the mafia
Join a side, or let them fight each other and you

about.p: Gorgonzola, King Chonk, Cthulhu, Mothzarella, a T-Rex and more, and they fight everyone.
A tank, a mech, a jet bomber, a wrecking crane, a bulldozer that plows through houses and the Fatcycle, a bat-bike that flies.
An Airport full of airliners, a Theme Park, a villain's volcano, Prison Island in a storm, a Moon Base in low gravity and more.
Play solo, or in private co-op by room code with voice chat. Late-90s console looks, on purpose, and an original breakbeat soundtrack.

games.name: Murder Mystery
games.tagline: Someone in the room is a murderer. Nobody knows who. One player gets the knife, another the sheriff's gun, and everyone else has three minutes to stay alive.
games.players: Up to 12 per room, public or private

about.lead: Someone in the room is a murderer. Nobody knows who.

about.p: Each round, one player is secretly handed the knife and another gets the sheriff's gun. Everyone else is innocent, with three minutes to stay alive.
Draw the blade from your hip and get close, or flick your wrist and throw it down a corridor. It comes back to your sheath a moment later. Take everyone out before the clock runs out.
One gun, one job: work out who the killer is and shoot first.
Run, hide and watch who's acting strange. If the sheriff goes down, the gun drops, and any innocent brave enough to grab it becomes the hero.

Ravenholt Manor, the Pier 9 docks, an office forty floors up, St Agatha's hospital, Tinkerton Toy Works, Hollow Lane on Halloween, Blackwater Penitentiary, the dungeons under Castle Grimhold, Maple Grove Plaza and a college dorm. Vote on the next map between rounds.
Jump into a public room of up to 12 players, or make a private room and share the code with friends.
Knife skins with auras, trails and kill effects, gun skins with coloured shots, and a rack of hats. Optional role tokens let you choose to be the murderer or the sheriff next round.

games.name: Buddy Beatdown
games.tagline: Punch the Buddy, now in VR! Grab weapons, explosives and physics toys to beat down your ragdoll Buddy with friends, then earn cash, level up and unlock even crazier items.
games.players: Solo, public lobbies or private rooms
games.ratingNotes: Violence, Blood. Users Interact, In-Game Purchases

about.lead: Punch the Buddy, now in VR! Play with friends.

about.p: Grab weapons, explosives, and physics toys to beat down your ragdoll Buddy. Earn cash, level up, and unlock even crazier items.
Endlessly satisfying demolition with tons of epic weapons, god powers, and vehicles. Every weapon hits harder than the last.
Jump into chaotic public lobbies, or go private with your friends. Unleash havoc on the Buddies (or each other).

Ram Buddies with vehicles, fling them with superpowers, and rig booby traps across wild maps built for combos, trickshots, and carnage. Mix it up with different characters, each with unique buddy-crushing powers.
Every hit earns you XP and cash – unlock the most powerful weapons in the game and amplify their destruction with unique buffs.

about.h: A major free update every month
about.p: New weapons, characters, vehicles, and modes have shipped every month since launch – and we're not slowing down. Join our Discord to vote on updates, share your videos in our creator program, and get special access to releases and giveaways.

games.name: Web Weaver
games.tagline: Swing. Fight. Flip. Repeat. A physics-based web-swinging superhero game with an open world, more than 7 campaign levels and friends along for the ride.

about.p: Swing, flip, fight, and pray your way through an incredible open world and more than 7 campaign levels. Web Weaver is a physics-based web-swinging superhero game where every jump is one bad grip away from glorious disaster. Even better, you can play with your friends.
Fully physics-driven web-swinging. No rails, no autopilot. Nail a perfect arc between rooftops and feel like a god. Miss and eat pavement.
Multiplayer mayhem. Swing together, fight each other, race through the city, or become city-wide menaces. Everything is better with a squad of web-weavers.
Crazy enemies. Tentacles. Grappling. Experience the most insane VR superhero combat on the market. Fast gameplay, multiple enemies, and unique web mechanics make Web Weaver combat a must-play.

about.lead: Grab a web. Get moving. Try not to scream.

games.name: Prison Break
games.tagline: Lights out is at ten. You won't be here for it. Plan a breakout as an inmate or keep Penville State Prison in line as a cop, with up to twelve players on each server.

about.lead: Lights out is at ten. You won't be here for it.

about.p: The bell rings at six. Roll call in the cafeteria, then off to your shift while a guard watches the door. Keep your head down. Eat your lunch. Shoot some hoops in the yard.

about.lead: And all day long, work on your plan.

about.p: Maybe it's the keycard you lifted off a guard who got too close. Maybe it's a loose panel deep in the vents, or the sewer under your feet, or a borrowed set of nurse's scrubs and a truly terrible disguise. Some ways out aren't written down anywhere. You'll have to find those yourself.
Keep Penville State Prison in line. Search pockets, snap on the cuffs, keep your taser close. When an alarm goes off across town, key your radio, jump in the squad car and floor it.

about.lead: Over the wall, the real fun starts.

about.p: Make it out and you're a wanted criminal loose in a town that never saw you coming. Hit the corner store. Slip past the lasers and crack the bank vault. Lie low at the scrapyard hideout, then roll back up to the gate and bust your friends out.
Up to twelve players share each server. Inmates plotting together, cops working the radio, the friend who swore they'd come back for you.
